segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for walking through the rollout plan today. Attached is the order form for 84 seats, starting May 15, with the services package we discussed.

Annual subscription: $58,800
Implementation: $6,500 one-time
Term: 12 months
Payment: net 30

If you can return the signed order by Friday, we can hold the May 22 admin training slot.

Best,
Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Mark,

Thanks. A few items before I send this to procurement:

1. We need 79 seats, not 84. Five users moved to the warehouse system.
2. Can the invoice split subscription and implementation into separate lines?
3. Legal will ask for a July 1 renewal date, even though go-live is May.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

Yep, I can revise to 79 seats and separate the invoice lines.

For the July 1 renewal date, we can set the initial term from May 15, 2026 through June 30, 2027, with the first period prorated. That keeps billing clean and gives your team the same go-live timeline.

Revised annual subscription for 79 seats is $55,300, plus $6,500 implementation.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Mark,

Procurement is pushing back. They budgeted $52K all-in for year one, including implementation. I know that's low based on your sheet, but that's what is sitting in the finance file.

If we can't get close, I may have to move this to Q3.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Dana,

Understood. Per our messages this morning, we can land it at $49,900 subscription plus $4,500 implementation for year one, and I'll get the deal desk paperwork cleaned up after so the order form matches.

I'll send the revised version with 79 seats, May 15 start, and June 30, 2027 end date.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Mark,

That works. Please make sure the order form shows the $54,400 total and the invoice lines separately. Also add the note that admin training is included, since our AP team checks the quote against the SOW.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

Attached is the revised order form and SOW.

Summary:
- 79 seats
- Subscription: $49,900
- Implementation: $4,500
- Start date: May 15, 2026
- End date: June 30, 2027
- Admin training included, up to 6 attendees
- Payment terms: net 30

Please have procurement sign page 4 and the SOW signature block.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Mark,

Received. Procurement is routing it now. One last item: can you confirm we can add 6 more seats in August at the same per-seat rate, prorated through June 30?

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Dana,

Yes, additional seats can be added in August at the same per-seat rate, prorated through June 30, 2027. I added that language to section 2.3 in the order form.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Mark,

Signed copies attached. Please send the invoice to ap@northvalleycomponents.com and copy me.

We are good for the May 22 training slot.

Dana
